ios.desc:
HondaMobile is the official communications app for news, information and resources related to your Honda employment.

Communications will include the following:

• Updates regarding the most recent news, events, and important information
• Timely alerts and announcements
• Employee benefits
• Videos
… and more!

quotes.story_title: Apple apologizes to WordPress, won’t force the free app to add purchases
